prompt: In a watercolor illustration, the scene unfolds at a bustling school science fair. On the far left, a boy in a blue cap stands proudly next to his project, a tall glass beaker filled with bubbling green liquid. The beaker sits on a wooden table covered by a white cloth. A girl with pigtails leans forward, pointing at the swirling mixture inside the glass. Beside her, a small orange cat sits on the edge of the table, watching the bubbles intently. In the center, a teacher in a yellow cardigan looks at a poster board displaying colorful charts. She holds a red pen in her right hand, poised to write feedback. Next to the teacher, a man in a grey suit gestures toward the charts, engaging in discussion. Behind them, a stack of three textbooks rests on a chair, slightly askew. To the right, a student with curly hair hands a pamphlet to an older woman wearing glasses. The woman accepts the paper with both hands, smiling warmly. Near them, a brown dog lies on the floor, chewing on a rubber bone. A silver trophy stands on a pedestal nearby, reflecting the ambient light. Above the crowd, a hanging banner reads 'Science Fair' in bold letters, though the text is stylized. A janitor in a blue uniform sweeps the floor in the background, pushing a broom. There is no digital screen visible in the setup. There is no plastic wrap covering any of the projects. The boy in the blue cap smiles broadly. The girl with pigtails has her mouth open in surprise. The orange cat has its tail curled around its paws. The teacher in the yellow cardigan tilts her head slightly. The man in the grey suit has his tie loosened. The student with curly hair has ink stains on their fingers. The older woman wearing glasses adjusts her frame. The brown dog has one ear perked up. The janitor in the blue uniform looks down at his work. The interaction between the girl and the beaker shows curiosity. The interaction between the teacher and the man shows collaboration. The interaction between the student and the woman shows sharing. The interaction between the cat and the beaker shows observation. The interaction between the boy and the table shows ownership.
